config_note:
vllm-metal + Gemma-4 MTP speculative decoding, agent split, 2026-08-25, 100 req/level.
Serve: --no-async-scheduling --speculative-config {"method":"mtp","model":"mlx-community/gemma-4-E4B-it-assistant-bf16","num_speculative_tokens":1}
The HF repo id resolves identically to a local copy (verified: same 355/517 draft acceptance either way), so the repo id is the portable form.
num_speculative_tokens=1 is not a tuning choice: the Gemma-4 assistant is a single MTP head and vllm_metal/v1/proposer.py:Gemma4MTPProposer calls propose_draft_token_ids once per step ('return one draft token per seed'). Setting 4 was measured to produce identical draft-token counts, acceptance and throughput -- it is silently ignored past the <=0 on/off check, not rejected. This is a Gemma-4 assistant limit; vllm-metal's draft-model and n-gram proposers do support multi-token drafts.
LIMITATION: MTP on Metal hard-requires --no-async-scheduling (vllm_metal/v1/spec_decode.py:129 raises NotImplementedError otherwise), while the 2026-08-22 vllm_metal baseline ran with async scheduling ON. The delta vs that baseline bundles MTP with the switch to synchronous scheduling and does not isolate MTP.
Otherwise matched to baseline: vllm-metal 0.3.0.dev20260821152549, max_num_batched_tokens=2048, --max-model-len 16384, memory fraction 0.5. The 7 failures/level are pre-existing (baseline also 93/100), not MTP-induced.
